rollbackTriggers: P1 affecting new users or public share recipients with no quick fix ready
Production /api/health returns 503 or any critical check is missing
Billing, auth, planner, or public sharing deployment fails its matching production QA gate
rollbackSteps: Identify the last known good production deployment in Vercel using the knownGoodDeployment entry.
Promote the last known good deployment to the production alias.
Confirm the production alias and health endpoint report the promoted deployment.
Run post-rollback production verification commands from this plan.
Record rollback reason, deployment URL, commit, command output, and follow-up owner in RELEASE_READINESS_MEMO.md and a qa/ evidence file.
Create or assign the follow-up fix branch from main before resuming release work.
